title: The Cuckoo Clock
summary: "The Cuckoo Clock" by Mrs. Molesworth is a children's fantasy novel published in 1877. Young Griselda struggles with loneliness in her new home until she discovers an unlikely companion: a cuckoo from an enchanted clock. Each night, the magical timepiece transports her to wondrous places where she learns valuable lessons about friendship, hard work, and self-control. Through fantastical adventures, this Victorian tale blends imagination with gentle moral guidance, teaching its young heroine—and readers—how to navigate feelings and find true companionship.
